remarks: Great end unit townhouse located in a quiet, convenient Stony Hill Village complex! Spacious living space in this 2 bedroom, 1 1/2 bath with an updated kitchen. Large dining room with slider doors to the deck, living room with a fireplace and 2 generously sized bedrooms on the upper level. Washer and dryer in unit. One reserved parking spot per unit with visitor parking close to the unit. Close to everything and minutes away from the highway. Good credit a must!
